title: Portuguese Cod Fritters
description: A traditional Portuguese recipe to make crispy cod fritters with a delicate balance of flavors. Serve as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. Rinse the cod under cold water, pat dry with paper towels, and cut into small pieces.
2. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, eggs, milk, and a pinch of salt.
3. Add the chopped parsley to the bowl and mix well.
4. Add the cod pieces to the bowl and gently fold into the mixture.
5. Gradually add the breadcrumbs to the bowl and mix until the fritter mixture is smooth.
6. Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
7. Using a spoon, drop small portions of the fritter mixture into the hot oil.
8. Fry the fritters until they are golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
9. Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
10. Serve the fritters hot with a side of your favorite dipping sauce.
